evidence.title: LLM Evaluation on Unseen Questions: Contextual Multidimensional IRT Model

summary: Researchers introduce a novel evaluation framework using a contextual multidimensional Item Response Theory (IRT) model to assess large language models' performance on previously unseen questions. The approach aims to provide more accurate and nuanced insights into AI capabilities.
title: New Contextual Multidimensional IRT Model Enhances LLM Evaluation on Unseen Questions
